胡九郎嬉皮笑脸的说道：

“别忘了我是做什么的，这还不是掐指一算？”

杨童狐疑的看着胡九郎，对于他的话自是不太信的，但是仿佛也找不到什么破绽。

“什么都不必说了，跟我去抓人！”

胡九郎摊开双手。

“那我们倒是走啊，在这里浪费时间？”

杨童白了胡九郎一眼，欲言又止，不过最终什么话都没有说。

魔都的灵隐寺平日里人流量极大，香火不断的，而且在三环以内，在寸土寸金的魔都，可谓是极其难得罕见。

灵隐寺占地也比较大，现在正是深夜，寺庙里显得格外的阴森，古香古色的大殿，凉风拂过，隐隐约约看到大佛的影子，极具压迫感，仿佛随时就要倒塌压过来。

一男一女的身影出现在这里，正是胡九郎和杨童。

杨童轻声道：

“莫奇卫在什么地方？”

不得不说，胡九郎的符篆确实是有些手段的，本来这莫奇卫已经被749局标记，是分分钟就能够抓住他的，如今却没有此人的任何气息，无论什么科技或者功法，都搜寻不到。

胡九郎撇了一下嘴，手中凌空划出一道符篆，符篆泛着一丝金光向前，砰的一声，四下散开，符篆如同化为一个个萤火虫，朝前方飞去。

胡九郎拉着杨童的小手就跟着这些“萤火虫”，走了几步，只觉得入手温润，心中也是一怔，杨童挣脱胡九郎的手。

“走吧，我能看的见！”

胡九郎于是专心跟着这些符篆化为的小亮点，饶过大佛，走了侧门出去，又穿过一座假山，最后来到一座枯井旁边。

胡九郎食指放在嘴边，嘘了一声，指了指井口，杨童心领神会，但见她一个跃起，直接进入井内，但听一声呵斥，轰然一声，杨童妙曼的身姿自井口跳出，紧接着几个黑影也是紧随而出。

胡九郎看到后面的那些黑影，脑袋不由得一缩，胡九郎看出来这些黑影并不是人，虽然有人的形状。

杨童双掌陡然挥出，两股强有力的无形真炁陡然将那几个黑影阻拦住，正是出阳功！

那些黑影发出咯咯的声音，犹如木偶顿时散架，落在地上四零八落，杨童上前看了一眼，眉头一皱。

“湘西赶尸人？”

胡九郎正要说话，但见一个人从井口爬了出来，那人一眼看到胡九郎。

Hu Jiulang said with a playful smile:

"Don't forget what I do. Isn't this just a matter of calculation?"

Yang Tong looked at Hu Jiulang suspiciously. He didn't really believe his words, but he couldn't seem to find any flaws.

"No need to say anything, just follow me to arrest people!"

Hu Jiulang spread his hands.

"Then let's go and waste time here?"

Yang Tong rolled his eyes at Hu Jiulang and hesitated to speak, but in the end he said nothing.

The Lingyin Temple in the Magic City usually has a huge flow of people and constant incense, and it is within the third ring road. In the Magic City where every inch of land is precious, it can be said to be extremely rare.

Lingyin Temple also occupies a relatively large area. It is late at night, and the temple looks particularly eerie. The cool breeze blows through the ancient hall, and you can vaguely see the shadow of the giant Buddha. It feels very oppressive, as if it is about to collapse at any time.

A man and a woman appeared here, it was Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong.

Yang Tong said softly:

"Where is Mochiwei?"

It has to be said that Hu Jiulang's talisman seal does have some tricks. Originally, Mo Qiwei had been marked by Bureau 749, and he could be caught in minutes. But now, there is no aura of this person, and no matter what technology or technique, he can't be found.

Hu Jiulang curled his lips and drew a talisman in the air in his hand. The talisman moved forward with a trace of golden light. With a bang, it spread out in all directions. The talisman seemed to turn into fireflies and flew forward.

Hu Jiulang took Yang Tong's little hand and followed these "fireflies" for a few steps. He felt warm in his hands and was startled in his heart. Yang Tong broke away from Hu Jiulang's hand.

"Come on, I can see it!"

Hu Jiulang then concentrated on following the small bright spots turned into these talismans, spared the big Buddha, walked out through the side door, passed through a rockery, and finally came to a dry well.

Hu Jiulang put his index finger to his mouth, hissed, and pointed at the mouth of the well. Yang Tong understood what she was doing, but saw her jump up and go directly into the well. However, with a scolding and a bang, Yang Tong's graceful figure jumped out from the mouth of the well, followed by several black shadows.

Hu Jiulang couldn't help but shrink his head when he saw the black figures behind him. Hu Jiulang could see that these black figures were not human beings, although they had human shapes.

Yang Tong suddenly waved out his palms, and two powerful invisible energies suddenly blocked those black shadows. This was the Yang Chuang Gong!

Those black shadows made a cackling sound, like puppets that suddenly fell apart and fell to pieces on the ground. Yang Tong stepped forward and took a look, frowning.

"Xiangxi corpse chaser?"

Hu Jiulang was about to speak when he saw a man crawling out of the well. The man saw Hu Jiulang at a glance.
